research.name: react-spring-bottom-sheet
research.note: React bottom sheet with spring snap points, rubber-band dragging and focus trapping, animated through CSS custom properties.

effects: sheet animation driven through CSS custom properties (--rsbs-overlay-h, --rsbs-overlay-translate-y, --rsbs-backdrop-opacity) instead of inline styles
rubber-band resistance when the sheet is dragged past its snap bounds
velocity-aware spring snapping between snap points
sticky header and footer that accept drag gestures
non-blocking mode that leaves the page behind the sheet interactive

unverified: The demo was not seen running: the homepage demos load only on a button click in a browser, and no browser was allowed in this session.
The repository and homepage contain no screenshots or recordings of the sheet; the only images seen were the logo illustration (readme.svg), the social card and an empty phone frame.
The signature effects are taken from the homepage text, the README and the source (style.css, BottomSheet.tsx), not from watching the motion, so how the animation looks and feels is not observed.
